name: Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF
summary: Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF is a high-performance liquid, alkalifree, set accelerator for shotcrete.
metaDescription: Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF is a high-performance liquid, alkalifree, set accelerator for shotcrete.
attributes: Distinct reduction of rebound and dust
Improved bond of shotcrete to the substrate
Chloride-free, no negative affect on reinforcement steel
usage: Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF is suitable for both dry and wet spraying processes and it is used for:
Excavation stabilisation in tunnelling and mining
advantages: Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF has the following characteristics and advantages:
Distinct reduction of rebound and dust
Improved bond of shotcrete to the substrate
Chloride-free, no negative affect on reinforcement steel

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 6 months from date of production if stored in original, undamaged and sealed containers.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Storage at temperatures between 5°C and 35°C. Protect from direct sun light, frost and contamination. Use clean containers when delivered in bulk. In case of separation of Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF the suspension has to be homogenised before using. Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF must not be stored in standard steel containers.

items.label: Specific advice
items.text:
Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF is added at the nozzle. Accurate and constant dosing into the concrete flow is essential.
The suitability of the proposed mix design must be tested in field trials be fore commencement of the project. High quality shotcrete requires a w/c ratio of less than 0.5. Temperature of basic mix must be higher than 15°C.

items.label: Substrate
items.text: The substrate must be clean, free of loose stones and free of water under hydrostatic pressure.

items.label: Recommended dosage
items.text: The correct dosage must be determined by preliminary testing. For layer thicknesses of up to 100 mm applied in one pass, the recommended accelerator dosage is between 5 % and 9 % by weight of binder. Lower ambient and basic mix temperatures require higher dosage of accelerator.

rel.s: Sika® Set Accelerator is a calcium-chloride based admixture used to reduce the setting time of concrete.
a: Reduced initial setting time of concrete.
Improved early strength development of concrete.
Reduction of delays due to cold weather.
Reduction of concrete bleed (due to faster set)
